notes.title: Demo update: progression saved and release date changed to April 14!
notes.notes:
Hello Cthulooters,

Due to other announcements and an opportunity, we've postponed the game's release by a few days, to Monday afternoon, April 14.

We hope you're not too disappointed. 

If you're from the press or a content creator, you can e-mail us for a key to the game at cthuloot@pixelnest.io.

Cheers,
CTHULOOT dev team

notes.title: Demo update - 0.53.0
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers!

We've just published a small update for the demo

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fix platforms not moving correctly in level 2
[*] Fix controller assignation on start edge case
[*] Fix potential softlocks in demo maps when playing solo
[*] Coinies are moving faster in level 3
[/list]

Have fun!

notes.title: 🏆 Demo update and Coop Fest participation! 🎉
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers,

To coincide with the launch of Coop Fest currently taking place on Steam, we've updated the playable demo for CTHULOOT.

💡 Feel free to let us know what you think of the demo here on Steam or on [url=https://discord.gg/FwUwUchAhw]Discord[/url]!

Happy treasure hunting!

notes.title: New CTHULOOT demo update
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers!

From today you can play the new version of the CTHULOOT demo for free:
[list]
[*]The essential beginner's tutorial
[*]The first level of the Lost Catacombs
[*]The Unfathomable Depths level
[*]The first Misty Reef level
[*]And the invisible catacombs
[/list]And discover the new version of Morgazhan's lair, full of surprises!

Don't hesitate to tell us what you think about the update on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/taMGFcG9qs]Discord[/url]!

Cheers,
CTHULOOT dev team

notes.title: Demo update!
notes.notes:
Hello!

We've reworked and updated the CTHULOOT demo!

Aside from the tutorial, the 4 available maps have been completely revamped for a better, funnier experience with more coop moments.

We hope you'll like it! Let us know what you think about it!
Leave a comment on Steam forum or on our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/taMGFcG9qs

Cheers!
